receipts.first_text_witness: You've got money sitting in checking doing nothing, and this year you've opened your brokerage app maybe 40 times without buying a single thing.
receipts.last_text_witness: Three funds, 4/100 of a percent, and the deeply unglamorous discipline of staying boring on purpose for longer than feels reasonable to you. Welcome to the least impressive strategy that works. The market doesn't pay you for being clever, it pays you for being present. So, the only real question left isn't what you should buy in August of 2026, it's whether you'll still own it in August of 2056.
